author: VenTheGentleman
quote:
AMAZING CONCEPT.... Horrible execution!

GTA 5 came out and it was a huge deal. I remember picking up Sleeping Dogs at the same times. I played through both single player campaigns and I realized, whiie I enjoyed Sleeping Dog's story mode more... GTA surpassed it in terms of the world, graphics, humor and freedom. 

I have played every single GTA since the very 1st one. What made GTA important is that it became the benchmark for everything. Every game was an upgrade toward something special.

Unfortunately, I can't say the same for GTA... 

After GTA 5, one of the central questions was how we expand and evolve. One idea I thought would be genius is to continue the theme of GTA 5 but explore different character types in more meaningful ways. The idea of playing as a woman is actually genius. Imagine being a female character in the GTA world and some guys harass you, then you can do GTA stuff to them. 

The idea of a female protagonist is not a bad one. It's excellent. Just like GTA allowed us to step into the body of A. A wealthy ****, B. A psychopath, C. A Hood black character... it actually does something important. It brings us all together as people and allows us to see the world through different eyes. A female character was golden opportunity to do the same, especially if she was a rational and cool character.

The female protagonist of this game... isn't rational. The game isn't rational. YES, GTA is meant to be an insane game, but by the end we are cheering for the protagonists and watch there journey + gain meaningful lessons from them.

What did I learn from this game???? 1. Your baby momma can lie, manipulate, hurt, complain about, abuse, misuse and cheat on you... and you die trying to simp for her. 2. Rockstar views itself as so lucrative and excellent that it can do whatever it wants... and people will buy it.

Well, the developers made a gross miscalculation. On tops of terrible leads, the game is buggy, ridiculous, broken and at times frustrating to play. It's mind boggling and forces you to wonder if all that 2 billion development + marketing budget was actually used on the game or just enriched a lot of invisible people.

You almost have to wonder if the behind-the-scenes development of this game should be the real GTA 6, because someone went for a heist and fans got robbed. And THAT deserves a 5 star police rating.
